courses.label: Preparation courses
courses.heading: Get ready to work abroad.
courses.intro: Explore language and vocational preparation courses and gain new knowledge and skills.

items.a: The platform helps employers find workers for the profession they need, and helps candidates apply for verified vacancies abroad and take preparation courses.

items.q: How do I submit a worker request?
items.a: Click the “Request workers” button and specify the profession, number of workers, language level and working conditions. We will review your request and get in touch with you.

items.q: How much do the services cost?
items.a: The price depends on the size of the request and the working conditions. A responsible specialist will tell you the exact price after you submit a request.
Yes, every vacancy on the platform is checked in advance for the employer and the working conditions.
There are jobs abroad in cooking, construction, warehousing, manufacturing and many other fields. The full list is in the “Vacancies” section.

items.q: How do I apply for a vacancy?
items.a: Choose the vacancy you want, click the “Details” button and submit an application with the required documents.

items.q: How do I sign up for language and vocational courses?
items.a: Choose a suitable course in the “Preparation courses” section and register. Information about the lessons will be sent to you.

items.q: How can I join as a partner?
items.a: Write or call us through the “Contact” section. We will discuss the terms of cooperation together.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Bandlik.uz takes the protection of users’ personal data seriously. This policy explains how data is collected, used and stored.

sections.p: When you submit a request, an application or a message, you give us details such as your name, phone number, message and the documents needed for an application. Technical data, such as browser type and language, may also be collected automatically when you use the site.
Your data is used only to review your request or application, to contact you, to improve the platform and to meet legal requirements.
Data is shared with employers and partners only to the extent needed to process your request or application, and with your knowledge. We do not sell personal data.
Data is stored for as long as needed for these purposes and is protected against unauthorized access by technical and organizational measures.
You may ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time. Write or call us through the “Contact” section of this website.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using the Bandlik.uz platform you agree to the following terms.

sections.p: Bandlik.uz is a platform that connects employers with candidates and offers preparation courses. The platform itself is not an employer.
You agree to provide accurate information, not to misuse the platform and not to submit other people’s data without their consent.
Vacancies, salaries and working conditions are shown as provided by employers and checked in advance. Details may change, so confirm the final terms before signing an agreement.
We make reasonable efforts to keep the platform available and accurate, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or any particular hiring result.
These terms may be updated from time to time; the current version is always on this page. For questions, use the “Contact” section.
